overview: The Tribunal of Order is the highest authority in Sanctus Seru. Doctrine is created here, purity is defined, and decree magic is forged.
history: Founded by Seru himself during the earliest days of imperial consolidation.
Arcane decree chambers were added to stabilize doctrine creation.
Purity sanctums were introduced to prevent ideological corruption.
Praetorian ceremonial guards were integrated to protect the Tribunal.
hooks: A doctrine pylon destabilizes during decree creation.
A purity sanctum reports a corrupted resonance signature.
A Praetorian ceremonial guard requests assistance with a sealed Tribunal edict.
